query:
UPDATE factory_step
            SET paused_at = CASE $3
                    WHEN 'pause' THEN now()
                    WHEN 'resume' THEN NULL
                    ELSE paused_at
                END,
                stop_asked_at = CASE WHEN $3 = 'stop' THEN now() ELSE stop_asked_at END,
                steer_action_id = COALESCE($4, steer_action_id)
            WHERE run_id = $1 AND seq = $2
